method.rules: Same original qualifications and original SL. Wait 0,15,30min. Cancel if original SL or original-reference1.25R touched during wait, or wait has a history gap. At delayed decision use that M15 open as reference; zero-delay control retains original reference. Optional same-direction preceding closed candle gate. First at reference, second at 0/10% original confirmation body. Pending entries expire 30min after delayed decision, not original confirmation. TP either original-reference1.25R unchanged or new-reference risk multiple1/1.25/1.5/2. Both directions. No BE or compounding.
method.limitations: All data reused; hindsight winners labeled. Same OHLC/path-uncertainty engine, M15 history and formerly fresh M1. Exclude unresolved. DD excludes floating losses. No daily/concurrent risk limits or margin. Execution at candle open is idealized, not a guaranteed market fill.
method.costs: Historical contract100oz, min/step.01, floor lots, second-only fallback when split fails. .20/.50 total gold price-unit cost plus $7/lot illustrative round trip. No observed current costs, tick rounding, executable bid/ask or broker-fill validation.
